title: Bible Story; Elisha and the Boys
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Teach the lesson (respect for the elderly and for God's servants), not fear: no child is told that bears will come for rude children (FAITH: teacher to confirm wording).

skills.key_step: The child retells Elisha and the boys (2 Kings 2:23-24) and names lessons: respect the elderly and God's servants, do not mock.

floor.question: Why should we obey our teachers?
floor.answer: They guide and care for us

steps: Say what the boys did wrong.
contexts: an old man walking slowly on the road

board.do: Wait for the child to say no.
Write the lessons: respect elders, respect God's servants, no mocking.

misconceptions.ask: The boys called Elisha "baldhead". Was that right?
misconceptions.repair: Ask how an old person feels when laughed at. Read the lesson: respect the elderly.

misconceptions.ask: How many bears came out of the woods?
misconceptions.repair: Read 2 Kings 2:24 and draw two bears and the number 42.

misconceptions.ask: Is being bald a reason to laugh at someone?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about how God made each person. Link with Psalm 139:14.

misconceptions.ask: What is the main lesson of Elisha and the boys?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: what did the boys do wrong? The lesson is about that.

checks.question: What did the boys call Elisha?
Name a lesson from the story.
